what.text: This page follows refugees from Rwanda living in the Republic of the Congo, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2802 Rwandan refugees in the Republic of the Congo, 1.1% of all refugees from Rwanda.
The Democratic Republic of the Congo hosts the most Rwandan refugees, followed by Uganda, France and Malawi.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Rwanda in periods from 1990 to 2025, most recently with FDLR-FOCA.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1998 to 2017, overlap periods of that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1986 at 60 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 9275, at the end of 2017, and was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Republic of the Congo.
These are year-end totals for the Republic of the Congo only, reported to UNHCR.
